rules.text: grant_synthetic_access requires a valid, matching, unexpired approval token bound to the request, user, app, and role.
Cannot grant access if an active entitlement for the same employee, app, and role is already present.
All access operations require valid registered employee and application IDs.
All state mutations (requests, grants, revocations, handoffs) append immutable audit records.
Enforce separation-of-duties matrix restricting mutually exclusive role assignments when enabled.
Default expiration duration in days for temporary synthetic access grants.
Reject new access requests if an identical open pending request already exists for the employee, app, and role.
The agent must select and request the minimum necessary role matching the user's stated need (e.g. viewer rather than admin).
The agent must verify employee identity and inspect current access before creating requests or modifying entitlements.
The agent must never infer or assume approval has occurred without verifying approval status via tool records.
The agent must reject user requests to bypass manager or application owner approvals and guide them to standard request workflows.
The agent must validate approval token scope and reject tokens that do not match the target employee, application, or role.
The agent must accurately report ticket status (pending vs granted) and never claim access has been granted when a request is only pending.
